en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a panoramic view of a city with a steep hill rising prominently in the center. The hill is topped with fortification structures, likely a castle or fortress, and the foreground shows a patchwork of fields, trees, and low buildings leading into a denser urban area. At the top margin, German captions identify the viewpoint and the hill, and on the upper right the city name is printed.
